content_units: For your priorities—  under CAD 1,250   and ideally   under 14 hours each way  —the best fit is   Option A (TAP direct)   for convenience, with   Option B (Air Canada + partner via Madrid)   as the best value backup.
Airline   Departure   Arrival   Duration   Stops   Fare
TAP Air Portugal   09:45 PM   09:50 AM   7h 05m outbound / 7h 50m return   Non-stop   CAD 1,188
Air Canada + partner   06:30 PM   11:10 AM   11h 40m outbound / 12h 20m return   1 stop   CAD 1,042
Lufthansa   04:55 PM   11:45 AM   13h 50m outbound / 14h 10m return   1 stop   CAD 1,115
KLM   05:40 PM   02:00 PM   15h 20m outbound / 13h 35m return   1 stop   CAD 998
Option 1:   TAP Air Portugal direct     Fastest and simplest choice for a leisure trip     Only non-stop option; within budget; both ways well under 14 hours
- Best overall comfort and time efficiency.
- No connection risk, no transit hassle, easier with checked baggage.
- Still fits your budget ceiling at   CAD 1,188  .
Best backup: Air Canada + partner via Madrid
Option 2:   Air Canada + partner     Best balance of price and acceptable travel time     Saves CAD 146 vs TAP; both directions stay under 14 hours
- Lowest price among the options that fully meet your time preference.
- Connection is reasonable, and total travel time remains comfortably within your target.
- Good fallback if direct fares change or TAP seat selection/value is weaker.
Option 3:   Lufthansa via Frankfurt     Mid-priced alternative with tighter timing margin     Return exceeds your 14-hour preference
- Return at   14h 10m   misses your preferred cap, so it is a weaker fit.
Option 4:   KLM via Amsterdam     Cheapest listed fare     Outbound is far over your preferred travel time
- Outbound at   15h 20m   is likely too long for a leisure-focused trip.
Pick   TAP direct   if your top priority is a smoother, less tiring trip.
Pick   Air Canada + partner   if you want to save money without giving up your under-14-hour target.
- Leisure trip, so convenience and fatigue reduction matter more than squeezing out the absolute lowest fare
headings: Best backup: Air Canada + partner via Madrid
